title: The masking version label, the covered ledger field IDs, the access-log granularity, the parameter rows and the login name of the access answer are not in the sources
source: RWB-E2-034 sections 1-19; FSD P4 A2.4, A2.5, A2.7, A2.16; TSD P4 T3.1, T3.2, T6.1; RWB-P2-E2034-CON; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-02, DP-06, DP-07, DP-08
description: The legacy story names the masking of the contact point by role and a matrix and masking version as screen and policy data, but the source set read for this work package does not state which masking version label is in force, which personal field IDs of a ledger entry the masking rows cover (the legacy names the contact point only, while the entry also carries a summary), whether the access log holds one AC-READ entry per answered read or per ledger entry, the parameter names and defaults of the access-log page and of the batch limit of field IDs per answer, the database login name of the service, or whether the authorise element stands inside the four ownership rows of the service. The story carries the placeholder at each of these points and fixes a behaviour only where a refusal is safer than a guess.
evidence: RWB-E2-034 section 3: retention class "ILG-STD" until Compliance sets the periods (DL26), and the contact point stored as a reference; section 12: GET /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/interactions with the fields of RWB-E1-068 and RWB-E2-022; FSD P4 AC-P4-007-01: one decision log entry with decision code AC-READ, actor, case ID, actions with DF-PTY-007 and DF-PTY-016 marked masked; TSD P4 T3.1: masking_rule has role_code, field_id, unmasked and masking_version but no default label; the Ownership Map rows of P4 list GET /admin/access-log, GET /admin/roles, GET /me/session and POST /admin/break-glass-grants, with authorise carried by the guard contract of RWB-P4-E1037-CON.
owner_role: Solution architect and the rwb-access contract owner
proposed: Settle the masking version label and the covered field IDs with Compliance and the data steward at the wave-2 policy load, confirm the AC-READ granularity with Internal audit, name the parameter rows and their defaults at build, and confirm the authorise element against the published RWB-P4-E1037-CON contract at contract review; the story's rules, criteria and tests then change in no value and in no refusal.
